mostWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the red cells revealed oxygen binding and release, connecting haemoglobin’s structure to oxygen delivery in tissues. The planned double-arrow inset makes that reversibility concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add red cells to the plasma mixture failed without explaining what preparation was missing. The compatibility feedback on the preceding attempt was more helpful.

surprise.text: The red cells had to bind oxygen before joining the sample. The result also distinguished reversible oxygen binding from the final blood composition.

arbitrary.text: Adding white cells and platelets before red cells, and preparing oxygen-bearing red cells before assembling blood, felt like game-imposed ordering rather than an explained biological necessity.

continue.text: I would continue for the concise structure–function connections, especially oxygen binding, though I would hope later assembly steps make their required order clearer.
